title: Myeongni 16-state B-track experiment line (JSONL)
description: B-track (NotebookLM / hypothesis) artifact only. Does NOT replace production myeongri fusion ledger. Relationship to MYEONGNI_FUSION_DECISION_JSON_SCHEMA: same optional stub; add hypothesis_tier=B and boundary_ack=true to acknowledge A/B separation and fact_lock discipline; join to ledger later via run_id/decision_id/ledger_join_key when promoting. Verse/Logos and regime/finance pipelines stay separate per workspace rules.

experiment_id.description: Stable id for this experiment batch (e.g. exp_16state_v1).

boundary_ack.description: Must be true: acknowledges A-track vs B-track boundary and no auto-merge with verse/ledger.

stub.description: Experiment stub marker; aligns with MYEONGNI_FUSION_DECISION_JSON_SCHEMA.stub usage.

ts_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for this line.

state_id.description: 4→16 expansion slot (research mapping only until validated).

mapping_target.description: BTC-style regime label for research mapping only; not a live trading trigger.

lambda_resonance.description: Optional hypothesis scalar; not verified production signal.

run_id.description: Optional correlation id; may align with fusion ledger run_id.

decision_id.description: Optional; future join to MYEONGNI fusion ledger line.

ledger_join_key.description: Optional join field name or value for promoted rows.

fact_lock.description: Optional; if present, same meaning as MYEONGNI_FUSION_DECISION_JSON_SCHEMA.fact_lock.

note.description: Short provenance or scope note (e.g. B-track only).

consistency_rate.description: Optional 0..1: higher = fewer internal contradictions across 16-state hypothesis vs base 4-state mapping.

self_contradiction_rate.description: Optional 0..1: higher = more detected self-contradiction in B-track narrative vs structured slots (inverse emphasis to consistency_rate; use one or both with clear methodology).
